description: This file defines the Controller class within the ElasticSearch module of SuiteCRM, responsible for handling Elasticsearch-related configuration, testing connections, and scheduling indexing jobs. It extends an abstract controller and includes methods for displaying the interface, saving and testing configuration, and managing scheduled jobs.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Controller class managing Elasticsearch configuration, testing connection, and scheduling indexing for SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Controller, calling parent constructor with a View instance.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the Elasticsearch settings view with current scheduler jobs.

methods.name: doSaveConfig
methods.description: Saves ElasticSearch configuration from POST data into the application config.

methods.name: doTestConnection
methods.description: Tests the connection to Elasticsearch with provided credentials and returns the status and info or errors.

methods.name: doFullIndex
methods.description: Schedules a full Elasticsearch index operation.

methods.name: doPartialIndex
methods.description: Schedules a partial Elasticsearch index operation.

methods.name: getSchedulers
methods.description: Retrieves scheduled jobs related to Elasticsearch indexing.

methods.name: scheduleIndex
methods.description: Creates and submits a scheduling job for Elasticsearch indexing, either full or partial.
